qualified_boundaries: global function assignments bind to canonical event IDs rather than manuscript text
alternative/unresolved function hypotheses may coexist without forced ranking
no mandatory three-act/beat template is enforced
intentionally unresolved setup/payoff, questions and arcs are valid first-class states
PAID_OFF/CLOSED states require actual referenced payoff/resolution events
function/setup-payoff/question/arc provenance and references fail closed when dangling
document/source bindings cannot drift from canonical narrative state
raw/revision manuscript text is forbidden from orchestration state
controlled vocabularies cannot encode mandatory plot templates or defect labels
dependency invalidation is precise across events/entities/claims
no literary quality score is emitted
authority_limit: This qualification proves orchestration representation and integrity behavior. It does not prove that an automated model correctly infers narrative function, setup/payoff, open-question status, or arc meaning from a manuscript.
